title: Topic Provisioning
description: Lifecycle of the topic created for a registered project. Topics follow keryx init: a project registered in the user-global project registry is provisioned a topic when a forum exists, and recorded pending until one does. Ordering between forum configuration and project registration must not matter.

projectId.description: References the project registry entry. The transport keeps no second list of projects.

state.description: pending: registered but no forum yet, or the topic was deleted and the project awaits re-provisioning. closed: the project's path went missing, so the topic was closed rather than deleted because it holds the conversation. failed: provisioning was attempted and could not complete.

bindingId.description: The topic binding created for this project. Present when provisioned or closed.

reason.description: A missing permission is reported as exactly that, never as a generic failure, because the operator's fix differs entirely.

detail.description: Safe explanation. No raw provider error body.

reopenRequiresOperator.description: A closed topic is reopened only by an explicit operator action; a path reappearing does not silently reopen it.
